Quick Snap on the green button (beta)

  • The palette now has a Liquid Glass background on macOS 26 and later, matching Apple's own green-button menu.
  • It uses about a tenth of the CPU it did while the pointer is moving, by skipping all work unless the pointer is near a window's top-left corner.
  • The Green Button section in Settings now shows which button it means, and says where to find it.
